video_title: Melo & Monica HEATED Debate Over Ja Morant & Dame Lillard's Fit in Portland

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt and Carmelo Anthony debate Ja Morant and Damian Lillard's fit
quotes.excerpt: Ja and Dame can't be on the floor together. It's way too small.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Now I'm fascinated by Portland because Ja and Dame can't be on the floor together. It's way too small.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Why not? It's guards. With which teams got big guards?

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: In the West? Okay, the other teams we just mentioned. Small guards just won. That was one. That was one and you have four people.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: But we're not talking about championship here. We're talking about teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: They can't be on the floor together. How are they going to be on the floor together?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony explains how Ja Morant and Damian Lillard could play together
quotes.excerpt: Ja is going to be able to lead the second unit. They know how to play off the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: Ja is going to be able to lead the second unit. They know how to play off the ball. They know how to play off the ball. You got Dillon Brooks, you got Kamara, you got Jrue Holiday.

text_blocks.speaker: Monica McNutt
text_blocks.text: Dillon Brooks can't move his feet.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: You got Jrue. So your lineup is Jrue, Ja, Dame, Dillon, and then, uh, then he's going to be.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the prevalence of switching defenses in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: Everything is a switch today. That's all you can do with that many guards.
quotes.quote: Everything is a switch today. That's all you can do with that many guards. Mike Malone would say take the mid-range out. When Minnesota says, Ja and Dame, just play off each other because they've been guarded by who? You know teams manipulate defenses. You know if it comes down to that, Ja is going to be on the nigger in the corner. You already know teams are going to manipulate that.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the defensive requirements for teams in the Western Conference
quotes.excerpt: You are going to have to compete on both sides of the ball in the West.
quotes.quote: To me, when you start talking about LA or Portland, you are going to have to compete on both sides of the ball in the West. You have to.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony evaluates Luka Doncic as a top player in the world
quotes.excerpt: On any given day, he could be the best player in the world.
quotes.quote: On any given day, he could be the best player in the world, Luka Doncic. I'm just saying. Luka is one of the best players in the world. He's not, he's not, see now you flipped it. You said he wasn't the best player in the world. I agree, Luka, for sure, with 1000%.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the parity of NBA teams entering the season
quotes.excerpt: Austin Reaves is a 24-point-per-game guy. Nobody's arguing that. What we're saying is everybody got better.
quotes.quote: Austin Reaves is a 24-point-per-game guy. Nobody's arguing that. What we're saying is everybody got better. Every team in the East. So you're not coming to the East just winning games no more. You're coming to play. In the West, you're coming to play. There's a lot of, there's even going into this season. So these teams, everybody's going to be there in the middle until January, February.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: Monica McNutt on the Dallas Mavericks' strategy to support Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: They were so deliberate about compensating for whatever weakness in his game.
quotes.quote: The Dallas Luka era, they were so deliberate about compensating for whatever weakness in his game. The Lakers have not been able to do that.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the importance of defensive effort for the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: JJ is demanding that he guard. And by guard, it's effort.
quotes.quote: Because the Lakers are, JJ is demanding that he guard. And by guard, it's effort. JJ is demanding the effort from him on that side. That's the difference.
